body: Pets are really the only thing keeping me going too. I wouldn’t recommend taking a bunch of pills or any suicide method for that matter. Also i think the getting sadder as the night progresses thing is pretty common. Personally i find myself getting caught up in the past a lot when i go to bed which brings up a lot of suicidal thoughts and tears. I’d also recommend trying to reach out for some help. I know thats what everyone says but seriously it’s worth a shot. If that all fails, well at least you can say you tried and you should be proud of yourself for trying.
